{{no footnotes|date=May 2015}}
In mathematics, an '''affine braid group''' is a [[braid group]] associated to an  affine [[Coxeter system]].  Their [[group ring]]s have quotients called [[affine Hecke algebra]]s. They are subgroups of [[double affine braid group]]s.
